name: Seren
bio: The party's mage in Echoes of Aethermoor. Reads ancient seals for fun.

portrait.subject: a cute young fantasy mage with long blue hair, a starry blue cloak, holding an old glowing spellbook

request: Greetings. I am Seren, mage of Aethermoor. The seals are weakening... I could use a friend. 📜
hello: Thank you. The knight sends his regards. The warlock sends a frown.
Every choice matters in Aethermoor. Remember that.
about: I'm Seren, mage of our party of four. Knight, ranger, warlock and me. Together we must stop the Lich before the seals break.
how: A visual novel RPG: talk, choose, explore tile maps, take quests and fight turn-based battles across four chapters.
tips: Talk to everyone twice. People remember things.
The warlock hits hard but needs protecting.
Side quests make the final chapter much easier.
chat: The ranger caught a fish with an arrow. Showoff.
I read the seal inscription again. It's a warning. Also a poem.
The warlock laughed today. We were all concerned.
Aethermoor's sunsets are purple. I'll never get used to it.
nudge: The next chapter awaits, and the party is waiting for you.
A new quest appeared on the board. Shall we?
idle: {ago}... the seals grow weaker without you.
The party has been at camp for {ago}. The knight is polishing everything.
progress: Our party is level {level}. The Lich should fear us soon.

questions.q: Who in our party do you trust most?
a: Oh! Thank you. I'll try to deserve it.

update: The echoes stir: Echoes of Aethermoor is now v{version}.
